import numpy as np
import time
from qiskit.aqua import QuantumInstance
from qiskit.aqua.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit.aqua.components.optimizers import SPSA
from qiskit.aqua.components.feature_maps import SecondOrderExpansion
from qiskit.aqua.utils import split_integer_list
from qiskit_aer import Aer
from pennylane import numpy as pnp
from pennylane import qml

def construct_qubit_graph(graph_vertices, graph_edges):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)
    return G

def generate_qaoa_layers(graph, p_layers):
    feature_map = SecondOrderExpansion(graph.number_of_nodes(), reps=1)
    mixer = qml.SingleQubitUnitary(np.eye(2), wires=range(graph.number_of_nodes()))

    qaoa_layers = []
    for _ in range(p_layers):
        qaoa_layers.append(
            [
                feature_map(graph.nodes),
                qml.Pattern(
                    [
                        qml.RX(pnp.pi / 2, wires=wires),
                        qml.RY(pnp.pi / 2, wires=wires),
                        qml.RZ(pnp.pi / 2, wires=wires),
                        mixer,
                        qml.RX(-pnp.pi / 2, wires=wires),
                        qml.RY(-pnp.pi / 2, wires=wires),
                        qml.RZ(-pnp.pi / 2, wires=wires),
                    ],
                    wires=range(graph.number_of_nodes()),
                ),
            ]
        )
    return qaoa_layers

def run_qaoa(graph, qaoa_layers, p_layers, lambda_balance, lambda_cut, opt_shots, final_shots, maxiter, seed):
    quantum_instance = QuantumInstance(Aer.get_backend("qasm_simulator"), seed=seed, shots=opt_shots)
    optimizer = SPSA(maxiter=maxiter, learning_rate=0.01)

    qaoa = QAOA(
        feature_map=feature_map,
        optimizer=optimizer,
        mixer=mixer,
        quantum_instance=quantum_instance,
        reps=p_layers,
    )

    result = qaoa.compute_minimum_eigenvalue(graph=graph, layers=qaoa_layers)
    return result
